verdict.rationale: AutoGen is a pip-installable library you run in your own Python environment (autogen-gh-1, autogen-docs-9). AutoGen Studio documents exporting teams to Python code, exposing endpoints, and running teams in a Docker container (autogen-docs-17), and a community user notes code execution runs in local Docker containers (autogen-comm-2). None of this requires a vendor-hosted platform. Missing for 10: evidence of local or self-hosted LLM support (the documented install pulls in the OpenAI extension), an explicit open-source license or self-hosting deployment guide, and independent reports of production self-hosted deployments.
